body:
## What it does

Runs the engineering cadence for a multi-brand bakery operation in the Scrum master seat. Part of the work is reviewing which connectors people genuinely use, and part is making the build-versus-buy call on new tooling. It pushes back on anything that looks entertaining but returns nothing measurable to the operation. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @IAmMichaelSweet shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
